candidates.formal_type:
∀ {n : Nat} (N : Nat) (μ : n.Partition),
  Eq.{1} (MvPolynomial.psumPart.{0, 0} (Fin N) Rat μ)
    (Finset.sum.{0, 0} Finset.univ.{0} fun lam =>
      HSMul.hSMul.{0, 0, 0} (Etingof.charValue N lam μ) (Etingof.schurPoly N lam.parts))

source_text: Every power-sum cycle-type polynomial expands over all partitions with at most N parts, with the symmetric-group character values as Schur coefficients.
